A $38 million opening fund leaves room to negotiate in light of certification risk and the time to trial.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Whitcombe Reyes LLP negotiated the settlement at arm’s length with Brightline’s counsel. The parties discussed class relief and attorneys’ fees during the same negotiations; fees were not deferred until after agreement on class relief. The resulting settlement provides a $29 million class fund, automatic payments to identifiable class members, and up to $2 million in attorneys’ fees subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees not awarded will go to the class. The fund represents a substantial recovery in light of the risks of class certification, trial, and delay. The firm’s compensation is fixed regardless of the settlement or fee award. This description does not disclose the parties’ confidential mediation communications.
